html:
A queen of Egypt who ruled as pharaoh for about twenty years in the New Kingdom, until 1458 BCE. She was the daughter of Thutmose I and wife of Thutmose II, and became regent for her young stepson Thutmose III before taking the crown herself.

Statues show her with a king's headcloth and false beard. Her reign was mostly peaceful and rich. She sent a famous expedition to Punt, which came back with myrrh trees, incense and ebony, and raised tall obelisks at Karnak. Her terraced temple at Deir el-Bahari, linked to her steward Senenmut, is one of the finest buildings of ancient Egypt.

After her death Thutmose III ruled alone and became a great conqueror. Late in his reign many of her images and names were cut away, perhaps to secure his son's claim. Her mummy was identified in 2007.
